classifications.rationale: The President presently adds the described parcel to the monument, reserves it, and extends the monument’s boundaries; the land designation and reservation occur through the proclamation itself.
classifications.evidence: the following described parcel of land is hereby added to and reserved as a part of the Bandelier National Monument

classifications.rationale: The President presently removes the described land and its interests from the monument and restores them to the public domain; those land-status changes occur through this segment itself.
classifications.evidence: is hereby excluded from the Bandelier National Monument and restored to the public domain

classifications.rationale: The President immediately subjects the added lands to the monument’s governing laws and regulations and imposes a substantive restriction on activities there, with the Commission determining which activities are noninterfering.
classifications.evidence: shall be subject to all the laws and regulations applicable to such monument

classifications.rationale: The President presently transfers the specified federal lands and interests to the Atomic Energy Commission’s administrative control; the transfer occurs through the proclamation itself.
classifications.evidence: are hereby transferred to the administrative control of the Atomic Energy Commission
